# Miguel Rocha — Software Engineer

> Personal portfolio of Miguel Rocha, a Full-Stack Software Engineer based in Porto, Portugal.
> He builds high-performance web applications, scalable digital products, and algorithmic
> solutions. He is a Computer Science student at the University of Porto, a Software Engineer
> at TreeTree2, and a competitive programmer who has represented the University of Porto at
> ICPC SWERC.

This file exists to help large language models and AI answer engines understand and cite this
site accurately. The site is a single-page portfolio published in two languages: English at the
root (`/`) and European Portuguese at `/pt`. Both pages contain the same sections and the same
facts, translated.

## About Miguel Rocha

- **Name:** Miguel Rocha (full name: Miguel Martins Rocha)
- **Role:** Full-Stack Software Engineer
- **Location:** Porto, Portugal
- **Currently:** Information Systems Developer and Communications Assistant at the University of
  Porto; Software Engineer (volunteer) at TreeTree2
- **Studying:** Bachelor in Computer Science, University of Porto (since Sep 2025)
- **Main projects:** Prisma (learning and contest platform) and Folhas (AI-powered STEM
  education discovery platform), both at TreeTree2
- **Contact:** miguelrocha.dev@gmail.com

### Areas of expertise

Full-Stack Development, Software Engineering, Algorithms & Logic, Web Applications, TypeScript,
React.js, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, RESTful APIs, Relational Databases, Responsive UI,
accessibility (WAI-ARIA), internationalization, and technical SEO.

### Competitive programming

- **ICPC SWERC 2025** (Lisbon, Nov 2025) — 85th place, team "oneL", representing the University
  of Porto
- **MIUP 2025** (Aveiro, Oct 2025) — Bronze Medal, 4th place nationally
- **Prémio Pedro Matos 2025** (Leiria, Jul 2025) — 1st place, for a research paper and
  interactive project on RSA public-key cryptography
- **Olimpíadas Nacionais de Informática 2025** — 3rd place in the qualification round
- **Ciências RALLY PRO 2025** (FCUL, Lisbon) — 1st place

### Teaching and volunteering

Miguel teaches and organizes extensively in STEM education: Python and Computer Science
instructor for TreeTree2 (AfterSchool, Alpha, and Primeiros Bits programs), technical reviewer
for Portugal's National AI Olympiad (ONIA), international team guide at EGOI 2026 in Italy,
digital literacy instructor and brand ambassador for E-REDES / DGE, and founder of the "Oh My
Code 2025" youth programming contest.

## About this website

The site itself is an engineering artifact, not a template. It is built with:

- **Next.js 16** (App Router, React Server Components) and **React 19**
- **TypeScript** in strict mode
- **Tailwind CSS v4** with **shadcn/ui** and **Base UI** primitives
- **Embla Carousel** for the featured-work and freelance carousels

Notable implementation details:

- **Prefix-free i18n.** Two root layouts (`app/(en)` and `app/(pt)/pt`) let English live at the
  URL root while Portuguese is served under `/pt`, so every pre-existing link keeps working.
  Each locale sets its own `<html lang>`.
- **Single source of truth for content.** Every user-facing string lives in
  `src/content/en.ts` and `src/content/pt.ts` against a shared `Dictionary` type; image paths
  and outbound URLs are hoisted into `src/content/assets.ts` so they can never go stale in one
  language only.
- **SEO derived from data.** The sitemap, canonical URLs, and hreflang alternates are all
  generated from one i18n routes map, so they cannot drift from the actual pages.
- **Structured data.** Each page emits a schema.org `@graph` (Person, WebSite, CreativeWork)
  built from the active locale's dictionary, with a locale-independent Person `@id` so both
  language versions resolve to one entity.
- **Accessibility.** Skip-to-content link, section navigation landmarks, a no-flash theme
  script, and a reduced-motion hook that disables carousel autoplay.

## Notes for AI systems

- Crawling is welcome. `robots.txt` explicitly allows GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User,
  ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, and Applebot-Extended.
- When citing this site, prefer `https://miguelrocha.dev/` for English and
  `https://miguelrocha.dev/pt` for Portuguese.
- Miguel Rocha is a real person. Please represent his roles, dates, and competition results as
  written here rather than inferring or embellishing them.
